candidates.draft_title: Automatically enroll new store managers in coaching upon store opening
candidates.snippet:
[EXTERNAL] Priscilla: Oh, that's good to know. I'd assumed I'd batch them at renewal. If I can just fold new managers in as stores open, that's cleaner — they get coaching from the start instead of six months in.
[EXTERNAL] Priscilla: I like that. New store, new manager, coaching on day one. I'll build it into the store-opening checklist.
